PatchingEarlyLayers.meaning: the layer band the early trigger-token recovery is averaged over

PatchingBadnetLastFull.meaning: badnet_a2o last layer at which the trigger tokens alone recover at least half the clean answer

PatchingRandomNullMax.meaning: largest recovery any random token group reaches, over every attack and layer

PatchingBadnetEarlyTrigger.meaning: badnet_a2o mean recovery from the trigger tokens over layers 1 to 6

PatchingBadnetCrossover.meaning: badnet_a2o layer at which the class token first recovers more than the trigger tokens

PatchingBadnetFinalCls.meaning: badnet_a2o class-token recovery at the last layer

PatchingLocalEarlyTrigger.meaning: mean early trigger-token recovery over the local-trigger attacks

PatchingGlobalEarlyTrigger.meaning: mean early trigger-token recovery over the global-trigger attacks

PatchingLocalCrossover.meaning: mean crossover layer over the local-trigger attacks

PatchingBlendEarlyTrigger.meaning: blend mean recovery from the trigger tokens over layers 1 to 6
